title: armeria maritima subsp. planifolia
intro: Armeria maritima subsp. planifolia, commonly known as Sea Thrift, is a flowering plant species within the Plumbaginaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Armeria maritima subsp. planifolia include anti-edematous and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help to reduce swelling and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
